content: How do I get started with local LLMs?
Start with Ollama or llama.cpp. Pick a small model like Llama 3.2 3B and run it on your machine.
Can I run Python CLI tools to analyze my chat logs?
Yes. This CLI reads local JSON chat logs and reports message counts, token estimates, top topics, and daily activity.
What about token estimates for budgeting?
This tool uses a rough ~4 characters per token heuristic. It is an estimate only.
